name-suggestion-index.purpose: Compile the brand/chain catalog used to recognise and suggest known businesses (e.g. Starbucks, Aldi) during POI search
name-suggestion-index.dataSent: Nothing per-request — the catalog is compiled from the published dataset at build time and matched in memory
name-suggestion-index.dataReceived: Brand names, Wikidata QIDs, matching OSM tags, and per-country name variants

wikimedia-commons-logos.purpose: Resolve a brand's logo image for display in search suggestions and place details
wikimedia-commons-logos.dataSent: The Wikimedia Commons filename referenced by the brand's catalog entry, requested through the image proxy so the browser never contacts Commons directly
